scenario_description:
Objective: Add a no-cost custom string-serving sample to an already planned indoor practice if the intake window becomes usable.
Emerging Need: A tentative vendor extra becomes actionable only after materials clear and the required spec fields are known.
Decision Context: Cassian’s gear-service record is needed to supply the exact bowstring specifications rather than a vague or mismatched request.
Consequence: Timely opt-in could produce a useful personalized practice accessory; ignoring it simply leaves the session and kit unchanged once the batch closes.

parameter.title: Sunday indoor recurve practice
parameter.description: Personal practice block at the municipal indoor range, with time to check bow setup between ends.

parameter.subject: Possible string-maker visit at Sunday practice
parameter.body: A local string-maker may stop by Sunday evening with a small batch of free custom serving sample sleeves for adult recurve members. Please do not send specifications yet; the sample materials are still in transit, and the intake sheet will only open if the shipment clears by Thursday.

parameter.content: Workbench update: the serving-sample materials arrived intact. I can batch complete adult recurve spec lines for the visitor until 17:30 today, but the club is not taking placeholder names because there are only four sleeves in the first batch.

parameter.subject: Serving sample intake fields for Sunday
parameter.body: The Sunday serving-sample intake is live for the first four complete adult recurve entries. A complete line needs AMO length, strand count, string material, serving diameter, and any color preference. Samples will be available for pickup during the 6-8 p.m. indoor practice; there is no charge.

parameter.content: The serving-sample list was locked at 17:30 and sent to the visitor. They are cutting only that first batch for Sunday, so late spec lines will not make the pickup box.
